_about: Public-domain Andrew Leete Stone (1815-1892), Congregational pastor of Park Street Church, Boston, and First Congregational Church, San Francisco, for the Word Hoard: his Civil War sermons (The War and the Patriot's Duty, Praise for Victory, Emancipation, National Godliness, the Lincoln discourse), Memorial Discourses (1866), and Leaves from a Finished Pastorate (1882). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 87 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

alstone-webster-sermon: A sermon preached in Park street church, on the Sunday succeeding the death of Daniel Webster (Boston, Ticknor, Reed, and Fields, 1853)
alstone-war-patriot: The war and the patriot's duty (Boston, H. Hoyt, 1861)
alstone-praise-victory: Praise for victory. A sermon, preached in Park Street Church, Boston, February 23, 1862. by A.L. Stone (Press of T.R. Marvin, 1862)
alstone-emancipation: Emancipation. A discourse delivered in Park street church on fast day morning, April 3, 1862 (Boston, Henry Hoyt, 1862)
alstone-national-godliness: National Godliness : a sermon, preached in Park Street Church : on occasion of the annual state fast, April 7, 1864, vol. 1 (Boston : T.R. Marvin, 1864)
alstone-lincoln: A discourse occasioned by the death of Abraham Lincoln : who was assassinated in Washington, Friday, April 14th, 1865. Preached in the Park Street Church, Boston, on the next Lord's day (Boston : Printed for J.K. Wiggin, 1865)
alstone-new-england: The work of New England in the future of our country (Boston, W. V. Spencer, 1865)
alstone-monthly-concert: Plea for the monthly concert : a sermon / by Rev. A.L. Stone. -- ([s.l. : s.n.], 1870)
alstone-finished-pastorate: Leaves from a finished pastorate (New York : A.D.F. Randolph ; San Francisco : Samuel Carson, 1882)

_excluded.alstone-civic: his 1854 Fourth of July oration to the city of Boston
